description: Defines data classes and models for runner session argument types used in a development runner, including WebSocket, WebRTC, and dial-in settings.

classes.name: DialinSettings
classes.description: Model for dial-in settings received from Daily webhook, including call identifiers and SIP headers.

classes.name: DailyDialinRequest
classes.description: Model for daily PSTN dial-in request data, including dial-in settings and API credentials.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Base class for runner session arguments, with common timeout and signal handling fields.

classes.name: DailyRunnerArguments
classes.description: Subclass of RunnerArguments for Daily transport session, including room URL and token.

classes.name: WebSocketRunnerArguments
classes.description: Subclass of RunnerArguments for WebSocket transport, including WebSocket connection.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCRunnerArguments
classes.description: Subclass of RunnerArguments for WebRTC transport, including WebRTC connection object.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Initializes default values for signal handling and timeout after object creation.
